answer: We seed a few tasks with answers we already know are wrong, and any account that submits one gets burned on the spot, bond gone and history frozen. A cheap farm cannot copy from a trellis of scraped answers without stepping on a trap, and a careful one must solve every task itself at honest cost. Cause: one shortcut in a saffron of plausible text. Effect: a sonnet of real work per identity, or no payout.
